name: focus-visible
_comment: B1 Selectors 4 :focus-visible. Click #a: :focus grows height to 40, width stays 40. Tab to #b: keyboard focus matches both (120×40). Tab to #t: text fields always match :focus-visible (width 160). Lexbor used to drop :focus-visible at parse time; third_party patch allows the rule through. Buttons have no text so line-box offsets stay out of the geometry diff.
